Understanding databases is important for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which look like spreadsheets with rows and columns. To get information from them, you write queries using a special language. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data differently, which is useful for large or changing datasets.

Data modeling helps you plan how your data is organized before you build anything. It makes your database easier to use and understand. Indexes are another helpful tool. They work like a book's index, helping the database find information quickly instead of searching every row. Good design makes databases fast and reliable.
